❤️
My Wellness Balance
▼
📌 What is it?Using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), it reads blood flow from your facial video to estimate your condition across 6 areas such as heart vitality, inner resilience, and stress.
📲 How to use
① In a bright place, fit your face inside the on-screen guide circle② Removing glasses & masks improves accuracy③ Look straight ahead without moving for ~15 sec
📊 ResultsScore per 6 areas + overall condition score + areas to watch today.
💡 TipAvoid intense exercise & caffeine right before; measuring at the same time daily makes trends clearer.
⚠️ For reference, not a medical diagnosis.
🧠
Cognitive Wellness Check
▼
📌 What is it?Checks brain condition via cognitive-screening questions (memory, attention, language) and adds guardian, medication & location management.
📲 How to use
① Solve cognitive questions in order (watch timed items)② Enable guardian linking to share results & location③ Register medication alerts
📊 ResultsScore per cognitive area + trend graph.
💡 TipMeasuring on the same weekday makes changes easier to see.
⚠️ For wellness reference only, not a diagnosis.
🧴
Scalp Care
▼
📌 What is it?Combines a magnified scalp image with facial rPPG biosignals to analyze scalp condition across 5 areas.
📲 How to use
① Part your hair so the scalp shows② Hold the camera close to the scalp, in focus③ Capture 5 areas in turn: crown, front, sides, etc.
📊 ResultsScalp condition per area + custom care guide.
💡 TipBright light, steady hands. Hair that isn't freshly washed can be more accurate.
💡
My IQ
▼
📌 What is it?Solve figure, sequence & language questions; meanwhile your accuracy, reaction speed & heart-rate stability measure focus/skill (BEI).
📲 How to use
① Choose Quick 25 · Standard 35 · Full 90 · Precise 150② Solve it in one sitting in a quiet place③ Keep your face visible when bio-resonance sync is on
📊 ResultsEstimated IQ + BEI (guessing vs. real skill) + strengths/weaknesses by area.
💡 TipStopping midway skews reaction-time data. Focus and finish in one go.
⚠️ FULI's own scale (beta). Not a Mensa or clinical IQ test.

📊 ResultsLeft and right eye clarity index + trend over time.
💡 TipIn your usual glasses/lenses, under the same lighting.
⚠️ Does not replace an eye exam.

🔤 Unfamiliar terms explained simply
ILI — Integrated Life Index
Short for Integrated Life Index. It fuses all Eastern & Western data — Saju, NASA celestial data, rPPG biosignals, numerology — to express your current energy state as 0–100 points. The higher the score, the better your energy today!
rPPG — Remote Photoplethysmography
Short for remote PhotoPlethysmoGraphy. camera-read skin color changes— a technology analyzing these to measure heart rate, blood flow & stress. Measured from facial video alone, without touching — a contactless method. (CGO applies this academically studied technology fused with divination & AR)
Five Elements (五行) — Wood·Fire·Earth·Metal·Water
The core of Eastern philosophy. It classifies all things into Wood (木)·Fire (火)·Earth (土)·Metal (金)·Water (水) five energies. Your birth date sets your elements, used in compatibility, shopping, food recommendations and more.
BEI — Brain Endurance Index
Brain Endurance Index. While solving IQ questions, accuracy·reaction time·and inner resilienceare analyzed together — CGO's own index distinguishing guessing from real skill.
SVI — Skin Vitality Index
Skin Vitality Index. Analyzes how fast your skin surface recovers after press-and-release, analyzing it by camera to quantify recovery elasticity. Use your smartphone instead of a costly beauty device!
Inner resilience — stress recovery elasticity
Heart Rate Variability. Measures the variation between heartbeats. Higher inner resilience means faster stress recovery. It's measured by rPPG scan.
MUFE — Dynamic Multi-Factor Security
CGO's own security technology. Post-quantum standard cryptography (ML-KEM-768) · real-time chaos key · biometric verificationare bound in 9 layers, designed so the password DB is never stored off-device (zero-storage).
VSOP87 — Celestial orbit calculation theory
The high-precision planetary orbit theory used by NASA JPL. in microseconds (millionths of a second), it computes solar-system planet positions and applies them to divination in real time.
50 divination systems — a full set of Eastern & Western philosophy
Saju, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Qi Men Dun Jia, Nine Star Ki, I Ching, Feng Shui, numerology, Tarot, Western astrology, Kabbalah and more — 30 Eastern + 20 Western systems applied together. A balanced analysis that doesn't lean on any single method!
BAI — Bio Activity Index
Bio Activity Index. Computed by combining inner resilience·vitality tone·facial rhythm·and biorhythm, your current total bio-energy score.
Perpetual Calendar (萬歲曆) — the base calendar for Saju
It converts your birth year·month·day·hour into Heavenly Stems & Earthly Branches (60 Gapja), a traditional calendar. It's the starting point for face reading, Saju, compatibility, etc., auto-computed from your entered birth date/time.
CSI — Conflict-Offset Index
Conflict-Offset Index. When the 50 systems reach different conclusions, it reconciles the conflicts into an overall scoreand transparently flags 'disagreement' when they diverge — CGO's own reconciliation method.
❓ FAQ
Q. The camera bio-scan isn't working ▼

A. You need to allow browser camera permission.📱 iOS Safari: Settings → Safari → Camera → Allow🤖 Android Chrome: Address-bar lock → Permissions → Allow camera💡 Installing as a PWA makes permissions easier!

Q. My ILI score is too low ▼

A. ILI reflects today's energy. On low days, it's best not to overexert.To improve accuracy, ① enter your name, birth date & time correctly and ② complete all 4 bio-scans!

Q. I want to install the app on my home screen ▼

A. the bottom 📲 Install button, or:📱 iPhone: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen🤖 Android: Chrome → Menu → Add to Home ScreenOnce installed, you can get notifications too!

Q. How do I measure SVI skin elasticity? ▼

A. Go to All Features → Skin Elasticity Analysis (SVI), thenhold the camera close to your skin and, on the on-screen circle, press and release with your finger. It's more accurate under bright light!

Q.Are the results the same as a hospital test?▼

A. No. All analyses are for infotainment & wellness reference, not a medical diagnosis. If you are worried about your health, be sure to consult a medical institution.

Q.Do I have to enter my info?▼

A. Yes. Saju, divination & ILI need your birth date/time to be computed. Before entering info, all features are locked . (Dashboard → Enter info)

Q.What is an rPPG bio-scan?▼

A. A method that uses the camera to read subtle facial blood-flow changes, reading them contactlessly to measure vitality tempo·inner resilience, and more. It’s more accurate when measured in a bright place without movement.

Q.My readings differ each time▼

A. Biosignals (heart rate, blood flow) vary with condition, lighting & posture — varying each time is normal. Try measuring several times under the same conditions.

Q.Is 'World's First' real?▼

A. It refers to CGO's own fusion structure, CGO-FULI's integrated technology. The key is the 'structure' binding these together, not the individual parts.

Q.Are IQ·BEI scores certified tests?▼

A. No. FULI's own scale (beta), not a Mensa or clinical IQ test. Please treat it as fun & self-check.

Q.Is my data safe? Where is it stored?▼

A. By default, measurement data is processed on-device. MUFE security aims for post-quantum cryptography and a zero-storage structure. (see the Privacy Policy for details)

Q.How do I earn and use Stars (⭐)?▼

A. Earn Stars via check-ins & activity, used for some features. My Page → Vault, where you can check them or top up at the Star Station.

Q.Should I trust the stocks, lucky numbers & fortunes?▼

A. All For reference & entertainment. Stocks especially are not investment advice — decisions & responsibility are your own.

Q.Where do I see the Detailed Analysis Report?▼

A. After completing info entry + bio-scan, All Features → Detailed Analysis Report, where you can see Saju, Nine-Star & ILI all at once.

Q.How do I do Couple Compatibility?▼

A. Each person measures their rPPG, then combines it with Saju to read real-time compatibility. All Features → Couple Compatibility, go there to proceed.

Q.How do I cancel/refund my subscription?▼

A. My Page → Subscription & Payment Management, where you can request it.

🎴 How to read tarot well (important!)
1️⃣ In a quiet place, bring your question clearly to mind

4️⃣ Cards aren't verdicts or prophecy — they're 'a mirror of you now'
5️⃣ Take results as reference; choices & decisions are always yours
⚠️ Tarot doesn't fix the future. Use it as a tool to sort out your thoughts.

My Wellness Balance
❤️
My Wellness Balance
CHROM rPPG · 5-area camera scan · AI tongue colour & coating · fused with 50 divination systems
📋 How to do it
In a bright place, fit your face in the guide circle and stay still for about 15 seconds — your state across 6 areas appears at a glance.
① In a bright place, put your face inside the guide circle
② Removing glasses and masks makes it more accurate
③ Look straight ahead without moving for 15 seconds
🫀 What is measured
CHROM rPPG
From the camera's light signal · contactless heart-rate reference
5 areas in turn
Face → tongue → eyes → skin → hands · colour and texture observed
AI tongue observation
Reference analysis from the tongue's colour and coating
4-7-8 breathing + HRV
Breathing rhythm and variability observed for reference
💡 Illumination correction Separates chromaticity from luminance and evens out brightness alone · stops below 25 lux
🌀 Motion compensation (SSR) Even if you speak or move your head, the shake is cancelled mathematically and only the pulse remains
🫀 Physiological constraint Real ranges of heart-rate change act as rules, trimming outliers on the spot
📏 Distance lock Locks itself outside 30–40 cm · distance is the root of accuracy
📊 What you get
A score for each of the 6 areas + overall condition + what to watch today
⚖️ An honest note
This is general wellness reference information. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, relieve or prevent disease, and does not replace medical judgment.

🎤 Press the voice button and just say «₩50,000 for materials» — done. The AI understands and asks whether to record it that way; if it's right, save. It's free, so use it as much as you like.
📷
② Snap a receipt
📷 Press the receipt button and photograph the receipt — the AI reads the amount, item and date and enters them. No typing. Fix anything wrong, then save.
📊 View·analyze — see your business status
Just record, and the below auto-calculates
📈
Income statement
It shows how much you earned (sales) and spent (costs) this month, and what's left (profit) — so you can tell at a glance whether the business is in the black.
💧
Cash flow statement
The real flow of money into and out of your account. It answers things like «I made a profit, so why is the account empty?»
🧾
Estimated VAT
It works out roughly how much VAT you'll owe later, so tax time doesn't catch you off guard.
💰
Cash status
It shows how much business cash you have now. View by today / this month / all.
📁 Organize·export
Put your records to use
📊
Export to Excel
Save your tidy ledger as a spreadsheet file and hand it straight to your accountant — easy at filing time.
🤖
AI tax consulting
'Can this expense be written off?'— ask any tax·accounting question and the AI answers simply. (for reference · confirm finally with your accountant)
💡 Pro tip
Just remember this
✨
Every day, as it happens!
Speak or snap the moment you buy or sell, and there's nothing to catch up on later. Voice is unlimited and free, so there's no pressure.
